documents.headline: FY26 Investor Presentation
documents.quote: Improved FY27 cash flow trajectory anticipated, driven by revenue growth and reduced cost base
documents.notes: The PRESENTATION has no guide. The market release, same company same day, carries a relational one. One document per company loses it.

documents.headline: FY26 Market Release
documents.quote: In FY27, US dollar gross profit growth is expected to be in line with or slightly ahead of the rate achieved in FY26, with gross margins maintained and operating costs held flat
documents.notes: Relational: a rate compared to last year, no absolute number.

documents.headline: FY26 Full Year Results Presentation
documents.quote: H1 FY27 will remain difficult as the weaker fourth-quarter order book carries into the new financial year
documents.notes: Clearest negative in the corpus, and it is ONLY in the presentation. Split horizon: H2 FY27 improves and builds into FY28.

documents.headline: FY26 Full Year Results Release
documents.quote: Focus on Furniture underperformed, and considerable work remains in its turnaround.
documents.notes: Same company, same day, and the H1-will-be-difficult line is absent. A model reading only releases scores Adairs mixed instead of negative.

documents.headline: AEF FY26 Results Investor Presentation
documents.quote: Targeting CTI in mid-60s over the medium term
documents.notes: Medium-term target, not next-year guidance.

documents.headline: AEF FY26 Results Announcement
documents.quote: Australian Ethical is targeting FY27 underlying expense growth to remain below revenue growth (subject to market movements)
documents.notes: Relational, and explicitly conditioned on markets.

documents.headline: Year Ended 30 June 2026 - Investor Presentation
documents.quote: FY27 net US tariff position remains fluid and the effective tariffs we face will likely continue to evolve
documents.notes: Genuinely hedged. Names an external risk it cannot size. Neither pessimism nor confidence.

documents.headline: FY26 Results Presentation
documents.quote: Total SH trading revenue flat in first 7 weeks vs PCP
documents.notes: Flat headline sales beside +11.4% ANZ comps. The two point different ways.

documents.headline: FY26 Results Announcement
documents.quote: First 7 weeks of FY27 maintaining momentum, with ANZ store comp sales growth of 11.4%
documents.notes: The release leads on the comp figure, the presentation on the flat total. Same seven weeks, opposite framing.

documents.headline: COS FY26 Results Presentation
documents.quote: IBM revenue, now representing 25% of the FY26 performance (from zero in FY23) and anticipated to grow to circa 45% of the FY27 revenue
documents.notes: A segment-mix number, not an earnings guide.

documents.headline: COS FY26 Results Announcement
documents.quote: Recently secured contracts in digital and data services give COSOL confidence that revenue will grow in FY27.
documents.notes: Confidence in growth with no magnitude. Also carries an interim-CEO transition that no tone label captures.

documents.headline: 1H 2026 Investor Presentation
documents.quote: Supports FY2026 outlook range of $250M-$270M
documents.notes: HALF-YEAR report, so the guided year is the CURRENT one. A model that maps document date to 'next FY' labels this wrong.

documents.headline: FY26 Results Announcement
documents.quote: we enter FY27 with a record order book of $650.8m
documents.notes: Order book is backlog, not guidance. The commonest false positive for a number-hunting extractor.

documents.headline: FY2026 Results Presentation
documents.quote: Genus forecasting to deliver circa $200m - $205m EBITDA FY2027

documents.headline: FY2026 Results Announcement
documents.quote: Forecast EBITDA for FY2027 to be in the range of $200-205 million.
documents.notes: Also guides recurring revenue ($764m) and capex ($65-70m).

documents.headline: FY26 Full Year Results Presentation
documents.quote: Trading for the first 8 weeks of FY27 saw Total Sales for this period +16.4% (on a constant currency basis)
documents.notes: A regex grabbed the +11.7% DIVIDEND increase from a nearby sentence instead of this. The near-miss is where a model earns its place.

documents.headline: FY26 Full Year Results Announcement
documents.quote: Trading for the first 8 weeks of FY27 saw total sales +16.4% (on a constant currency basis) on the same period in FY26 and comparable store sales +3.0%

documents.headline: FY2026 Investor Presentation
documents.quote: FY27 GUIDANCE ... Between $540m and $580m Revenue ... Between $54m and $58m Net Profit After Tax ... +50% vs FY26 ... +40% vs FY26
documents.notes: THE MOST QUANTIFIED GUIDE IN THE CORPUS, and sentence-based extraction misses it entirely: it is a slide layout, not prose. Any extractor that splits on sentences scores this as no guidance.

documents.headline: Full Year Results - Investor Presentation
documents.quote: FY27 is expected to deliver modest growth. It is a year of strategic investment
documents.notes: 'Modest' is the whole signal. A polarity score reads it as positive and loses the qualifier.

documents.headline: Full Year Results Announcement
documents.quote: The Company's EBITDA is expected to have modest growth in FY27, assuming IC3 SuperWest Phase 1 revenue commences in 2H FY27.
documents.notes: Conditional on a project milestone. The condition is load-bearing and no sentiment label carries it.

documents.headline: Monadelphous Reports 2026 Full Year Results
documents.quote: more than $680 million in new contracts secured since the beginning of the new financial year

documents.headline: 2026 Full Year Results Presentation
documents.quote: FY27 is a year to consolidate and position for future growth
documents.notes: 'Consolidate' is a soft word doing real work. It sits beside 'Strong long-term outlook' in the same deck, which is the tension one score erases.

documents.headline: NRW Full Year Results - ASX Release
documents.quote: FY27 Underlying EBITA guidance of $320 million to $330 million
documents.notes: Cleanest example in the set: named metric, named range, named year, plus revenue $4.6-4.8bn with ~85% secured.

documents.headline: ASX Announcement - FY26 Full Year Results
documents.quote: Construction of PolyNovo's new manufacturing facility was completed, with validation activities progressing ahead of planned transition in FY27
documents.notes: Operational milestone. No forward financial statement at all.

documents.headline: Half Year Results 2026 Investor Presentation
documents.quote: Distribution partnerships continue to drive growth
documents.notes: EXTRACTION POOR. Top candidates were an Acknowledgement of Country and a contents page.

documents.headline: FY26 Results ASX Announcement
documents.quote: Consistent with previous practice, we will be providing FY27 Guidance in November.
documents.notes: Explicitly declines to guide, then gives an FY29 target ($1bn revenue, $200m EBITDA). A four-year target is not next-year guidance and must not be scored as one.

documents.headline: FY26 Results Presentation
documents.quote: Step One will continue to execute the plan to reset the business
documents.notes: EXTRACTION POOR: five of seven candidates were safe-harbour boilerplate. The only concrete forward statement is conditional (dividends resume once retained earnings turn positive).

documents.headline: FY26 Results Presentation
documents.quote: Store network of 88 with five new stores opened during the year and one planned closure
documents.notes: No forward financial statement. Store-count operational detail only.

documents.headline: FY26 Results Announcement
documents.quote: The Group is well positioned heading into FY27.
documents.notes: NULL SIGNAL. Textbook boilerplate optimism with no content. If a model scores this like NWH's guided range, the feature measures house style.

documents.headline: FY26 Results Presentation
documents.quote: ASC expected to continue to be strong in 1HFY27
documents.notes: FY26 landed at the upper end of its own guidance, which is BACKWARD-looking and reads identically to forward guidance to a keyword filter.

documents.headline: FY26 Results - Upper End of Guidance
documents.quote: propeller orders increasing into Q4FY26 and continuing into FY27
documents.notes: Headline says 'Upper End of Guidance' about FY26. The word guidance appears four times and never about FY27.

documents.headline: FY26 Results Investor Presentation
documents.quote: Operating EBIT +61% to $67.2 million, exceeding top-end of guidance range
documents.notes: Backward-looking guidance achievement. The FY27 outlook is in the release, not here.

documents.headline: FY26 Results Announcement and Change of Registered Address
documents.quote: FY27 Outlook Market conditions experienced in the second half of FY26 are expected to continue into FY27.
documents.notes: Relational: an H2 run-rate carried forward. No number, but a real and checkable claim.
